auth_triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION on_signup()
auth_triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.on_signup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles(id, email, phone, name, country, dob, photo)
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    new.phone,
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'country',
    nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'dob', '')::date,
    nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'photo', '')
  );
  return new;
end
$function$

notes: One application trigger was observed on auth.users: on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT calls public.on_signup().

public.on_signup() inserts a matching public.profiles row and copies name, country, date of birth, and photo from raw_user_meta_data; these are profile attributes only and must never be treated as authorization claims.
The auth schema and its managed tables remain Supabase platform dependencies. Recreate only the application-owned trigger/function dependency through a reviewed migration where appropriate.
